Record Class AotCacheReport

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.runner.build.aotcache.AotCacheReport
Record Components:
jdk - the exact VM build, java.vm.version
os - the operating system, os.name
arch - the CPU architecture, os.arch
labels - what the caller added, such as the target
creationFlags - the flags the cache was created with
recordStop - how the recording ended: "jcmd" (jcmd <pid> AOT.end_recording), "driver" (the training stop: a signal or the stop path) or "exit" (an application that ran to its exit)
probes - how many strict probes ran
probeFailures - how many of them failed
classesLoaded - the classes the strict smoke launch loaded up to the end of its workload
classesFromCache - how many of them came from the cache
coverage - classesFromCache / classesLoaded
micronautLoaded - the io.micronaut classes the smoke launch loaded
micronautFromCache - how many of them came from the cache
micronautNotFromCache - the names of the others
runtimeLambdas - the lambda proxy classes the smoke launch spun instead of loading them from the cache
warnings - what the build warned about
failures - why the gate failed; empty when it passed
verdict - "passed" or "failed"
public record AotCacheReport(String jdk, String os, String arch, Map<String,String> labels, List<String> creationFlags, String recordStop, int probes, int probeFailures, int classesLoaded, int classesFromCache, double coverage, int micronautLoaded, int micronautFromCache, List<String> micronautNotFromCache, int runtimeLambdas, List<String> warnings, List<String> failures, String verdict) extends Record
What the verification gate found, written as "aot-report.json" next to the cache.
Since:
1.0
